name: benzocaine + docusate
purpose: Purpose (Benzocaine).............. Anesthetic (Docusate Sodium).... Stool Softener Laxative
uses: Uses For the relief of occasional constipation (irregularity). This product generally produces a bowel movement in 2 to 15 minutes.
otcwarn: Do not use If individual is sensitive to Benzocaine If you are presently taking mineral oil, unless directed by a doctor. When abdominal pain, nausea or vomiting are present. For a period longer than 1 week unless directed by a doctor. Stop use and ask a doctor if: Symptoms last more than 2 weeks. You have rectal bleeding or fail to have a bowel movement after use. This may indicate a serious condition.
